name: Lateral Ankle Sprain
definition: Traumatic injury of the lateral ankle ligament complex, most commonly the anterior talofibular ligament, after inversion/plantar-flexion injury.

redFlags.item: Syndesmotic/high ankle injury with severe instability

core: Anterior drawer/talar tilt after acute pain permits

investigations.principle: Use validated Ottawa rules to guide radiography.
investigations.MRI: MRI is not routine initially; used for persistent symptoms or suspected osteochondral/tendon injury.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs when Ottawa criteria or clinical suspicion indicate.

green: Early protected weight bearing as tolerated
amber: Persistent instability or high-grade syndesmotic injury requires specialist assessment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Gulpha-sandhi/Snayu injury phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Traumatic injury of the lateral ankle ligament complex, most commonly the anterior talofibular ligament, after inversion/plantar-flexion injury.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, breathing/swallowing difficulty, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
